name: Freelance deliverable
summary: A digital work product handed over privately, with proof of delivery — and no marketplace fee.
description: A client commissions a digital deliverable — a design file, a production cut, a dataset, an access credential — from an independent professional. The hand-off travels an encrypted channel straight between the two of them, and a fingerprint of the file is recorded as proof it arrived. Both sides are bonded, so the client's payment and the freelancer's delivery secure each other; the freelancer's catalogue can price a fixed fee or by the hour. No marketplace takes a cut.
